title: Halo hero
description: A full-screen black panel with 6 to 10px of paper showing around it and 8px corners. A tall product shot fills it; on desktop a giant brand word sits bottom-left with the tagline at the lower right, on phones only the tagline and an orange play button stay at the bottom-left.
notes: black panel in any theme: it uses the dark tokens
the media slot is the product photo or video; empty it is a graphite surface with an orange glow
pair with halodental-sonnet-header, which lies on top
name: halodental-sonnet-hero

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the giant brand word, bottom-left (desktop only)

props.name: tagline
props.description: the tagline: bottom-right on desktop, bottom-left on phones

props.name: play
props.description: label and link of the orange play button (phones only); leave out to hide it

props.name: media
props.description: the product photo or video, filling the panel. Empty shows the placeholder.
